jobs.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are seeking a proactive, technically strong, and collaborative SDETto own and drive quality engineering activities within a dedicated product development track (pod) delivering complex software solutions.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a proactive, technically strong, and collaborative SDETto own and drive quality engineering activities within a dedicated product development track (pod) delivering complex software solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring the ability to independently define and execute a quality strategy, collaborate closely with developers and product stakeholders, and integrate quality practices throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

We are evolving beyond traditional, manual-heavy QA approaches toward AI-assisted, automation-first quality engineering. The ideal candidate is technically curious, adaptable, and excited about leveraging modern tools to improve software quality, accelerate delivery, and reduce repetitive work.

Key responsibilities

  • Own quality within the pod: Lead and coordinate all QA activities for a dedicated development track, ensuring quality is embedded throughout the SDLC rather than treated as a final testing phase.
  • Drive test strategy: Define risk-based testing approaches and appropriate coverage across API, integration, functional, end-to-end, and non-functional testing.
  • Champion test automation: Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using modern frameworks and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with frontend and backend developers, product owners, and other stakeholders to identify risks, clarify requirements, and prevent defects early.
  • Integrate quality into delivery: Ensure automated quality checks are incorporated into CI/CD pipelines and evolve alongside application changes.
  • Provide quality visibility: Communicate risks, coverage gaps, testing outcomes, and release readiness using meaningful, actionable quality signals.
  • Continuously improve: Identify bottlenecks, challenge inefficient processes, and introduce practical improvements that increase delivery speed without compromising quality.
  • Lead by example: Promote shared ownership of quality, mentor team members when needed, and foster a collaborative, learning-oriented engineering culture.

Required qualifications

  • Proven ability to independently lead QA activities for a development team delivering complex software applications
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, APIs, integrations, and modern SDLC practices
  • Practical programming experience in at least one language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools or demonstrated ability and enthusiasm to adopt them
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills

Nice to have

  • Experience with Cypress, Playwright, Pytest, or similar automation frameworks
  • Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, and complex API integrations
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions, Jira, and modern development workflows
  • Experience leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate test development and maintenance
  • Experience with performance testing, observability, or production quality analysis

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

jobs.description:
Interested? Click here to apply now!

 

About the Role:

At TELUS Digital, we are advancing the future of Artificial Intelligence by helping AI systems understand, process, and generate human speech with greater accuracy and naturalness.

As an AI Speech & Audio Specialist in our AI Community, you will contribute to the development and improvement of next-generation speech AI technologies, including Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), Text-to-Speech (TTS), Voice AI, and audio machine learning systems.

We rely on our global community of specialists to evaluate, create, refine, and improve high-quality speech and audio datasets. Your expertise in audio production, speech analysis, linguistics, or voice technology will help ensure AI models deliver natural, accurate, culturally relevant, and human-like voice experiences.

At TELUS Digital, you will play a key role in shaping how AI listens, understands, and communicates with people around the world.

 

Key Responsibilities:

·         Evaluate AI-generated speech (TTS) for naturalness, pronunciation accuracy, rhythm, tone, emotion, and overall voice quality.

·         Review and improve speech recognition outputs (ASR) by identifying transcription errors, pronunciation issues, accents, and linguistic nuances.

·         Perform professional audio editing tasks including segmentation, trimming, noise reduction, silence adjustment, and quality enhancement.

·         Analyze audio recordings using waveform and spectrogram-based tools to identify quality issues.

·         Support the creation and validation of high-quality speech datasets used for AI model training and evaluation.

·         Review voice recordings for clarity, consistency, articulation, and technical quality.

·         Perform audio quality checks including loudness levels, background noise detection, clipping, distortion, and export specifications.

·         Support voice AI projects including TTS, ASR, voice generation, voice similarity, voice mimicry, and conversational AI evaluation.

·         Apply expertise in phonetics, linguistics, audio engineering, or speech technology to improve AI-generated voice experiences.

 

Qualification path

Mandatory Qualifications:

Education / Professional Background:

Minimum of one of the following:

·         Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in:

·         Audio Engineering

·         Sound Engineering

·         Music Technology

·         Linguistics

·         Phonetics

·         Speech-Language Pathology

·         Computational Linguistics

·         Computer Science (Speech/AI focus)

·         Related audio or speech fields

 

OR

Professional experience in:

 

·         Audio production

·         Sound design

·         Dialogue editing

·         Voice recording

·         Podcast/audio post-production

·         Speech data creation

·         AI speech projects

·         Technical Experience:

·         Experience with at least one professional audio tool:

·         Adobe Audition

·         iZotope RX

·         Pro Tools

·         Reaper

·         Audacity

·         Logic Pro

·         Cubase

·         Other Digital Audio Workstations (DAWs)

 

Knowledge of:

·         Audio editing and restoration

·         Noise reduction

·         Speech segmentation

·         Spectrogram analysis

·         Audio quality assessment

·         Voice/audio processing workflows

Language Requirements:

·         Native-level proficiency (C1/C2+) in the required language is preferred for language-specific projects.

·         Ability to identify pronunciation, accent, and linguistic nuances.

·         English proficiency sufficient to understand technical instructions and project guidelines.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with:

·         Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)

·         Text-to-Speech (TTS)

·         Voice AI

·         Speech datasets

·         Audio annotation

·         Voice cloning or voice mimicry projects

·         ADR / dubbing

·         Localization audio

·         Broadcast or media production

·         AI model evaluation

 

Assessment:

·         To join the TELUS Digital AI Community, candidates will complete:

·         Subject-specific qualification assessment

·         Practical audio/speech evaluation (where applicable)

·         Identity verification process

 

The assessment may include:

 

·         Audio quality evaluation

·         Speech recognition review

·         Audio editing tasks

·         Voice quality analysis

·         Linguistic accuracy evaluation

 

Payment:

Currently, pay rates for specialists range from $6 - $40 USD per hour depending on expertise, project complexity, and market requirements. *Location and language is directly dependent.

Payment terms and rates are defined separately for each project engagement.

Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:

·         Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

·         Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

·         Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

·         Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects.

·         Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship:

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Senior QA Engineer

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.

  • Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.

  • Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

  • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality role.
  • Strong proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with proven commercial experience on a shipped title or game currently in active production.
  • Solid understanding of game development pipelines and the relationship between engineering, design, art, production, and QA.
  • Experience creating and maintaining structured test plans, test cases, and regression coverage.
  • Strong bug investigation and reproduction skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly and precisely.
  • Working knowledge of one or more relevant scripting or programming technologies, such as Python, C#, Lua, Unreal Blueprints, or Unreal scripting tools.
  • Experience with QA and bug-tracking platforms such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Bugzilla.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and continuous integration/delivery workflows.
  • Experience analysing QA data, defect trends, and testing results to identify patterns and areas of risk.
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and discussing issues directly with engineers.
  • Highly organised and capable of independently managing priorities across multiple features and areas of development.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • A proactive approach to quality, with the ability to identify potential issues before they become larger production problems.
  • Genuine interest in games and a strong understanding of what makes gameplay feel polished, responsive, and enjoyable.
  • Must be based in Europe or a CET-compatible time zone, with sufficient overlap with Central European working hours to participate consistently in daily collaboration, meetings, and team syncs.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing networked gameplay and debugging issues involving replication, latency, matchmaking, or online services.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated testing frameworks, scripts, or QA tools.

  • AAA game development experience.
  • Experience working within a fully remote, multinational game development team.
  • Experience contributing to a title through multiple stages of production, from early development through launch.
  • An active interest in competitive and multiplayer games.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplinary team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

Audio Editor – Multitrack Dialogue

  • Location: Remote
  • Type: Contract (20 to 35 hours per week, 2 to 4 weeks initially with potential to extend)
  • Duration: Immediate start; group training on Monday, October 27
You’ll master multitrack recordings from our production studio and deliver them to spec through our platform. Each session captures a user mic, an assistant mic and four channels from a Zoom field recorder. The four-channel portion is where most of the work lives: each channel needs individual leveling, noise reduction and timing alignment so the mix stays even across the stereo field. You’ll work from a rubric, hand off to QA, and flag recording issues (camera movement during dialogue, sync problems) back to the production team.
This is a hands-on editing role. We’re looking for people who can work channel by channel in a DAW, not people who rely on one-click AI cleanup tools.

What you’ll do

  • Master roughly one file per 3 hours: clean, denoise, level and align six tracks per session
  • Apply and adjust processing per channel; correct timing offsets between channels
  • Deliver files in the required format and loudness spec through our platform
  • Follow the QA rubric and incorporate feedback from reviewers
  • Note recurring audio problems so the studio team can fix them at the source

What we’re looking for

  • Proficiency in a professional DAW (Reaper, Pro Tools, Adobe Audition, Logic or similar)
  • Experience with multitrack dialogue editing and field recorder audio
  • Strong noise reduction skills (iZotope RX or comparable)
  • Ability to hear and correct timing and phase issues between channels
  • Consistency and speed; you can hit a quality bar repeatedly across dozens of files
  • Availability for full-time hours for at least the next two weeks

Nice to have

  • Background in podcast, film or broadcast post-production
  • Experience working to a rubric or client spec at volume
  • Familiarity with Zoom H-series or F-series recorders
